extra_context: We're a family dental practice and I see everyone from toddlers getting their first cleaning to grandparents, all under one roof. A lot of our patients come to us because they're honestly nervous about the dentist, so the whole vibe I want is calm and reassuring, nothing clinical or cold. The one thing people always mention is our "no rush" policy: we never double-book, so you actually get unhurried time in the chair and we explain everything before we do it.
